The props are defined in `FormEngineProps` in the form engine library, and two applications render `FormEngine`: the patient chart's form-entry app and the form builder's preview. The form-engine lib's own tests also render it.

**Where the props are defined**
- `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/form-engine.component.tsx` declares `interface FormEngineProps` (lines 24–40). The `FormEngine` component destructures these at lines 42–58.
- The default export is `I18FormEngine` (lines 228–236), which takes the same `FormEngineProps` and wraps `FormEngine` in Suspense and i18n. The default export is at line 238.
- `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/index.ts` line 11 re-exports it as `FormEngine`, so that is the name consumers import.

**Applications that render it**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-engine-app/src/form-renderer/form-renderer.component.tsx` renders `FormEngine` at lines 95–109 and passes most of the props (`encounterUUID`, `formJson`, `formSessionIntent`, `handleClose`, `handleConfirmQuestionDeletion`, `hideControls`, `hidePatientBanner`, `markFormAsDirty`, `mode`, `onSubmit`, `patientUUID`, `preFilledQuestions`, `visit`). This component is the form-entry workspace that the vitals app opens when `useFormEngine` is set (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/utils.ts` lines 16–23).
- `openmrs-esm-form-builder/src/components/form-renderer/form-renderer.component.tsx` renders it at line 82 with only `formJson`, `mode` and `patientUUID`.

**Likely affected, not fully read**
- `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib/src/form-engine.test.tsx` (render at line 1421), `src/zscore-tests/*.test.tsx`, `src/subform-loading.test.tsx`, `src/components/inputs/unspecified/unspecified.test.tsx`, `src/components/inputs/multi-select/multi-select.test.tsx` and `src/components/inputs/ui-select-extended/ui-select-extended.test.tsx` all render it. I only saw the matched lines, not the full files.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-engine-app/src/form-renderer/form-renderer.test.tsx` mocks `FormEngine`, so it would need its mock updated.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/{en-US,fr-FR}/docs/forms-in-o3/using-forms-in-applications.mdx` show usage examples of `FormEngine` with props, which would need updating.

**What I could not check**
- The `find_symbol_*` tools failed with the short repo name, so I used grep instead. I only searched `.ts` and `.tsx` files for `FormEngine`. Repositories outside those hits, or dynamic usage, would not appear.
- I did not read the `FormRendererProps` type in `esm-patient-common-lib`, which supplies the wrapper props in the chart app.
